Copper is essential to all living organisms and is a universally important cofactor for many hundreds of metalloenzymes. Copper deficiency is widespread and appears in many forms.

The human equivalent shows up as gray hair, aneurysms (the tensile-strength failure), varicose veins, and Menkes' kinky hair syndrome. Wallach pairs copper with zinc in the supplementation framework — they compete for absorption, so isolated zinc supplementation can precipitate copper deficiency. The Healthy Body Start Pak delivers both at Wallach's chosen ratio rather than either alone.
